protocol.selection: seeded event-stratified unique anchors; all scenarios share samples; first sampled event label used for multi-label anchors
protocol.no_vision: all BEV evidence removed; inference ablation, not a trained nonvisual model
protocol.delay: real earlier cached BEVs; age refers to BEV query timestamps, not exact camera exposure age; tokens aligned using causal localization
protocol.delay_boundary: pre-window delayed observations unavailable, not padded with future evidence
protocol.fixed5: anchor only; fixed visual memory; reset hidden, zero previous action and step=0 as refresh candidate
protocol.teacher_forced: future expert prefix is diagnostic only, not deployable performance
protocol.motion_initialized: extra historical ego-motion input; inference diagnostic, not a retrained architecture
protocol.ci: not computed; no authoritative log map supplied
protocol.adaptation: robustness evaluation only; checkpoint unchanged, no stale-input finetuning

delay_controls.fresh_short_history_control: fresh observations but omit the first max(stale_steps) history frames
delay_controls.delayed_zero_age_diagnostic: largest delay with token age input set to zero; knowingly incorrect metadata, diagnostic only
